sentences.japanese: 君は独りで泳ぎに行ける歳ではない。
sentences.english: You are not old enough to go swimming by yourself.

sentences.japanese: 君はもう独り立ちしてもよい年齢だ。
sentences.english: You are old enough to stand on your own feet.

sentences.japanese: もう独り立ちすべき時だよ。
sentences.english: It's time you stood on your own two feet.

sentences.japanese: メアリーはどうしようかと独り言をいった。
sentences.english: Mary said to herself "What shall I do?".

sentences.japanese: ペリーは独り言を言う癖がついた。
sentences.english: Perry has acquired the habit of thinking aloud.
